Virtual Administrative Assistant

JAK Concrete Coatings

Países permitidosMéxico, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (GMT-09:00 to GMT-07:00)
Idioma requeridoEnglish (Conversational)
ExperienciaProficient in virtual assistance, scheduling, bookkeeping, and CRM
Salario$8 to $11 USD/hour (~$155 to $214 MXN/hour, negotiable)
HorarioFreelance (aligned with GMT-09:00 to GMT-07:00)
Tipo de contrataciónFreelance
Fecha de publicación2026-11-25 (Límite: 2026-12-25)

Descripción del puesto

Serve as the first point of contact for customers and manage daily administrative operations in Jobber, including scheduling, invoicing, warranties, and basic bookkeeping.

Funciones principales

  • Answer incoming calls, emails, and website inquiries, and schedule consultations and installations.
  • Follow up on job quotes and proposals, prepare invoices, and register manufacturer warranties.
  • Track employee payroll hours, assist with basic bookkeeping, and maintain inventory/equipment logs.
  • Operate Jobber to keep CRM records, project photos, and documentation up to date.

Requisitos

  • Proficiency in virtual assistance, customer service, scheduling, and document management.
  • Experience with basic bookkeeping, payroll tracking, and CRM/Jobber workflows.
  • Conversational English, strong organization, and proactive communication.

Beneficios

  • Negotiable hourly rate of $8 to $11 USD.
  • 100% remote freelance role supporting a growing service business.
